EAX=selected actor; ECX=actor vtable; EBX=0x2A; EDX=0x19

dispatch.coordinate_order: 57050 sign-extends DX and BX; 57070 forwards DX as component X and BX as component Y
dispatch.wrapper_mode: 57050 sets 0x115B58 while invoking the actor virtual +0x24. 57070 skips its normal shadow pass and does not subtract virtual-height/64 from the supplied Y in this mode. The ordinary wrapper shade, visibility, and color rules still apply.

checks: Actual admitted actor frame is composited on a full 640x480 indexed frame at (25,42).
Independent component pixel walk matches the complete resulting indexed framebuffer.
The portrait changes left-panel pixels and leaves the 512-pixel world viewport unchanged.
A synthetic negative-origin clipped draw matches the same independent pixel walk.

limitations: This closes the portrait draw call and coordinates only; it does not claim a complete selected panel, text layout, or whole-screen renderer.
The caller supplies the selected actor slot, selected player, frame counter, and world/layer order.
